study_strategy.warning: Many Asteraceae look similar from a distance. Use head structure and involucre details, not just a yellow flower photo.

b067_study_strategy.warning: Coreopsis wrightii has been synonymized with C. basalis in older ITIS/FNA treatments, but current Kew accepts it as a distinct species. Preserve that conflict explicitly.

quick_split: C. wrightii — annual, narrow linear foliage, yellow rays usually with rusty-red/maroon basal markings; local PASS.
C. lanceolata — rhizomatous perennial, broader lanceolate lower leaves, long nearly leafless peduncles, all-yellow heads; range HOLD.
C. basalis — existing annual golden-wave anchor; broader/divided foliage than typical C. wrightii.
C. tinctoria — existing annual plains coreopsis anchor with strongly bicolored yellow/maroon rays.
